en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

This is our last day living 
here, huh...?

I thought I'd be happy about it, but I 
don't want it to end...I'm a little sad.

It was just for a short while, but we did
go through a lot. I'm a little sad too.

Ah, but of course, I'm still
more happy than sad.

Are you going to go back to astronaut
training when you get out of here?
Of course!

No way I'd give up on my dream 
of becoming an astronaut!

I lost time here, so once I get back, 
I'm gonna train harder than before!

I'm gonna make up all my lost time 
as fast as I can!

That's true, while we were in here, the
other trainees were training every day.

Yeah, it's gonna be hard work 
closing that gap!

But, y'know, coming here...
I think it was good for me.

One reason was because I 
got to meet you...

But also, I was able to practice the 
most important thing for an astronaut.
The most important thing?

What? I told you before, didn't I?
Don't tell me you forgot.
Ah, of course...

<CLT=cltMIND>The most important thing
for an astronaut...
Leadership
Adapting to any environment
Communication
...Leadership, right?

Yeah, that's definitely important 
for an astronaut.

But that's not the most important 
thing, as far as I'm concerned.
Hey, did you really forget about it?

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
The most important thing must be...

...The ability to adapt to any
environment, right?

Well, yeah. Adapting to your
environment is important...

But there's something more important 
than that. Did you seriously forget?

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
The most important thing must be...
...Good communication, right?
Ah, so you did remember it.

No matter how great you are, you can't be 
an astronaut if you can't communicate.

A fight on a spaceship because of bad 
communication could be fatal, right?

Yeah, I imagine that would
be terrible.

The universe is a hostile place, so 
communication is really important.

But our daily lives here were 
the same way, right?

Being shut away and told 
to live together...

Living together here was probably even 
harder than living in a spaceship.

Well, you learned a lot about
communication here.

Living here must have been
good training for you.

Yeah, I won't waste what 
I learned here.
But it's the same for you, right?
What?

Just how living here helped me 
in my astronaut training...

I think it helped you with your 
detective work, too.

Maybe the time you spent here will 
be useful for your future, y'know?

Isn't there something you 
gained here?
Yeah, I suppose I have.
<CLT=cltMIND>Skills every detective needs...
<CLT=cltMIND>Skills every human being needs...
<CLT=cltMIND>And above all else...

<CLT=cltMIND>I was so lucky to make
a friend like Kaito.
Thank you for everything.
I'm really glad I met you, Kaito.

What are you talking about!?
That's my line!

I'm glad I got to meet you, Shuichi! 
You'll always be my sidekick, alright!?
Yes, of course!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I beamed at one
another and shook hands.

<CLT=cltMIND>We both put all our strength
into the handshake.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm really glad I met Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>So in at least *one* way,
I'm thankful to Monokuma.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure Kaito feels the same way.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we don't have to tell each
other that. We don't need words.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know exactly how Kaito
feels, without them.

<CLT=cltMIND>This bond might just be the special
<CLT=cltSTRONG>something<CLT=cltMIND> I acquired here.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
